name: bzip2.wasm
description: bzip2 compression library compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:optimized
scripts.build:wasm: emcc -O3 blocksort.c huffman.c crctable.c randtable.c compress.c decompress.c bzlib.c src/wasm_module.c -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_bzip2_compress_buffer","_bzip2_decompress_buffer","_bzip2_compress_bound","_bzip2_get_version","_bzip2_error_string","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=32MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=256MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=2MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto -I. -o build/bzip2.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:optimized && npm run build:simd && npm run build:compact
scripts.benchmark:compare: npm run benchmark && npm run benchmark:optimized

author: WASM Ecosystem Contributors
